title: feat(clipboard): add a ⌘K action card and open panel entries by double-click
risk: low: existing key monitor and services, no new permission
what: Adds a ⌘K action card listing every clipboard-entry action (paste, copy, edit, Dictionary, reveal, pin, delete) and makes double-clicking a panel entry open the window on it.

title: feat(clipboard): drag entries out and shake to open the Shelf
risk: low: AppKit drag source on existing Shelf drop path
what: Switches the card's Preview to Quick Look, preselects the first row, and lets files, images and optionally text drag out of the clipboard window, with shake opening the Shelf.

title: feat(widgets): add a desktop performance widget
risk: high: new widget extension target, extra signing and build steps
what: Ships a sandboxed desktop widget extension that renders a read-only snapshot of CPU, GPU, memory pressure and boot volume sampled by the app.

title: feat(i18n): add Arabic and Persian, the first right-to-left languages
risk: medium: RTL layout changes across every surface
what: Adds Arabic and Persian catalogs and RTL layout direction across 40 hosting roots, pinning horizontal axes (graphs, timelines, diagrams) where mirroring would break meaning.

title: Add Hebrew localization
risk: medium: RTL changes across all hosting roots
what: Adds a Hebrew catalog plus RTL mirroring, direction-aware SF Symbol swaps and AppKit reflections; documents a chrome versus in-app-language mismatch limitation.

title: fix(recorder): keep a clicked window's sheets and dialogs in the recording
risk: medium: live ScreenCaptureKit filter swapping, untested live
what: Records a clicked window through its display with an include-list filter and swaps the filter four times a second so sheets and dialogs appear mid-recording.

title: feat(dock-number-switch): jump to a Dock app with the Super key and its number
risk: low: Carbon hotkeys on existing Accessibility grant
what: Adds off-by-default Hyper-layer number hotkeys that activate or launch the Nth Dock application and cycle its windows when already frontmost.

title: feat: add per-app Shortcut Guard
risk: medium: dedicated keyboard event tap and Accessibility dependency
what: Adds an opt-in utility that blocks user-recorded keyboard shortcuts only while selected apps or bundleless processes are frontmost, via a dedicated event tap.

title: fix(snippets): clear an inline completion before deleting a trigger
risk: low: bounded AX query on the existing event tap
what: Queries the focused element's selected text before deleting a snippet trigger and posts one extra delete, fixing a stranded first character in browser address bars.

title: Implement deep link handling
risk: low: URL scheme registration reusing existing dispatch
what: Adds a vorssaint://run/<id> URL scheme that executes a Command Bar row through its normal path for Shortcuts, scripts and launchers.

title: feat(menu-bar): tint whole memory block under pressure
what: Tints the full RAM menu-bar block (label, value, bar outline) with the existing pressure colors on warning or critical memory pressure.

title: feat(homebrew): keep the last operation log
risk: low: retained log text in Homebrew settings
what: Stops completion cleanup from erasing the Homebrew log and adds a View last log footer in Settings once the status clears.

title: feat(homebrew): open elevated commands via .command
risk: low: writes a temp script and opens an external handler
what: Replaces hardcoded Terminal AppleScript with an executable .command script opened through NSWorkspace's default handler for sudo, installer and shell setup.

title: feat(menu-bar): show the current Space number
risk: low: reads existing Space topology bridge
what: Adds an off-by-default Space metric showing the current Space's 1-based index on the menu-bar display, refreshed when the active Space changes.

title: feat(keep-awake): selectable closed-lid gate conditions
risk: low: NWPathMonitor plus existing power and display sources
what: Lets closed-lid keep-awake require an external display, AC power and/or network availability, with Any/All matching and migrated existing settings.

title: feat(menu-bar): optional battery percent without icon
what: Adds an off-by-default Monitor setting that shows battery charge as percent text only, covering both the readable and dense metric paths.

title: feat(switcher): pause hotkeys in frontmost apps
risk: low: reuses existing exception-list and hotkey pass-through
what: Adds a separate App Switcher exception list so listed frontmost apps, such as remote desktops, receive the switcher shortcut instead of Vorssaint claiming it.

title: fix(monitor): fall back to named HID temperatures on m1
risk: high: four private HID symbols resolved at runtime
what: Adds a runtime-resolved HID temperature fallback for missing M1 CPU/GPU readings, used by fan curves, plus a read-only temperature diagnostics command.

title: feat(finder): optional cut and paste sounds
what: Adds an opt-in setting that plays the system Pop sound when a Finder cut mark or a successful move happens.

title: feat(mouse-buttons): allow unmodified key shortcuts
what: Lets mouse-button mappings record and post bare keys such as Return without loosening validation for global hotkeys.

title: feat(menu-bar): optional system-colored usage bars
what: Adds a Monitor toggle that paints CPU, GPU, memory and disk usage bars with the system label color instead of per-threshold hex colors.

title: feat(dictation): add provider-backed voice dictation
risk: high: audio leaves the Mac, provider keys, mic and Accessibility
what: Adds configurable provider-backed dictation with microphone and language settings, paste at the cursor or clipboard fallback, Keychain keys and optional private history.

title: feat(overlay): add screen annotation tools
risk: medium: full-screen overlay window and event pass-through
what: Adds a pass-through screen annotation overlay with pen, highlighter, arrows, shapes, solid redaction, text, selection, eraser, colors, width and undo.

title: feat: turn wi-fi off while sleeping
risk: medium: radio off during sleep and restore-debt persistence
what: Adds an opt-in Energy feature that powers Wi-Fi off before sleep and restores it only when Vorssaint made the change, using CoreWLAN.

title: feat(mouse): short-click shortcuts on Spaces-drag button
risk: medium: shared mouse-button state machine, unverified input paths
what: Lets one extra mouse button both arm the Spaces drag gesture and fire a configured shortcut on a still short release.

title: feat(brightness): link all displays for simultaneous adjustment
risk: low: reuses existing brightness service write path
what: Adds an opt-in toggle that shifts every adjustable display's brightness by the same delta, clamping at 0 and 1, with the OSD left on the source display.

title: feat(clipboard): optional capture, paste, and failure sounds
risk: low: NSSound playback gated by pure helpers
what: Adds three off-by-default clipboard sound toggles for capture, successful paste or copy, and failures, using the Pop and Basso system sounds.

title: feat(shelf): rename and trash files from the tile menu
risk: medium: destructive rename and trash of user files
what: Adds Rename and Move to Trash to the Shelf tile context menu, with validated names, bookmark healing and background trashing that only drops items actually trashed.

title: feat(command-bar): add web search as a last result
risk: low: opens an https URL, no new dependency or permission
what: Adds a final Command Bar row that searches the web in the default browser, with DuckDuckGo default and a ⌘K picker for Kagi, Google, Bing, Yahoo or Ecosia.

title: fix(screenshot): focus preview by default for ⌘C/⌘S
risk: medium: changes default focus behavior, may steal focus
what: Defaults the capture preview to take keyboard focus, activating and making its window key so ⌘C and ⌘S work without clicking first.

title: feat(finder): Space on folders opens Get Info
risk: medium: global event tap claims Space and reads Finder selection
what: Adds an opt-in Finder shortcut where Space on folders opens Get Info while files keep Quick Look, classifying the selection off the event-tap thread.

title: feat(finder): move the selection to the trash with the forward delete key
risk: medium: rewrites system-wide key down and up in a shared tap
what: Adds an opt-in Finder shortcut where bare forward delete is rewritten to ⌘⌫, keeping Finder's undo, Put Back, prompts and Trash sound.

title: feat(eye-guard): add a scheduled work and break screen
risk: low: public APIs, shielding-level window, no new permission
what: Adds an opt-in work/break cycle that fades all screens to black for breaks, with presets, a 10-second warning and idle time counted as break.

title: feat(screenshot): add %app token for save folders and names
risk: low: pattern expansion in existing save path
what: Expands a new %app token to the frontmost app's name in screenshot subfolder and filename patterns, sanitized to one path component.

title: fix(media): clarify compression Low/Medium/High meaning
what: Rewords the compression buttons so they state the quality-versus-file-size trade-off, updated across locales and pinned in tests.

title: feat(auto-quit): link the exception list from the menu panel row
risk: low: reuses existing panel accessory and settings route
what: Adds an exception-count link to the Quit on close menu panel row that opens the Settings page holding the per-app exception list.

title: fix(mic-mute): release a microphone left muted with nothing claiming it
risk: medium: can unmute a device the user silenced manually
what: Keeps a bounded record of every device a mute reached and releases orphans once per launch when a voice-processing session swallowed the unmute.

title: I18n/vietnamese localization
risk: low: catalog additions plus a build-script change
what: Adds Vietnamese across every catalog, Info.plist and permission prompts, and compiles the icon generator with swiftc instead of the JIT interpreter.

title: feat(color-picker): optional menu bar icon for the system color panel
risk: low: AppKit NSColorPanel and NSStatusItem only
what: Adds an off-by-default menu bar icon that opens the system color panel with its wheel and saved palettes while the Color picker feature is installed.

title: feat(shelf): preview tiles with Quick Look
risk: low: drives existing QLPreviewPanel from a nonactivating panel
what: Adds Space and a context-menu entry to preview the Shelf selection, or everything when none is selected, through the shared QLPreviewPanel.

title: feat(shelf): compress and copy files from the tile menu
risk: low: reuses existing archiver and naming helpers
what: Adds Finder-style Copy and Compress to Shelf tiles, zipping beside originals through the island's existing ditto archiver and never touching originals.

title: feat(shelf): drive the shelf from the keyboard
risk: low: pure support helpers on the existing key panel

risk: medium: new Info.plist service and document type per locale

risk: high: private SkyLight and CGVirtualDisplay SPI plus virtual displays

title: Add keep-awake detail view to the Dynamic Island
risk: low: island view and state additions only

risk: medium: window and PID heuristics, unvalidated on real panels

risk: low: key handling in existing clipboard monitor

title: feat(port-manager): include UDP listeners

title: feat(media-keys): send playback keys to the music player

title: feat(notch): show when Claude is waiting for a reply, and pin the limit window
risk: low: reads existing Claude session JSON
what: Adds an opt-in orange badge and island notice when a Claude session is waiting on a reply, plus pinning the session or weekly limit window.

title: feat(notch): show each limit's length before its percentage
risk: low: string formatting across readout call sites
what: Adds a switch that prefixes the closed island's limit reading with its window length (5h/7d) in the app's language; depends on #2234.

title: feat(panel): drag the panel off the menu bar to keep it open
risk: low: uses existing popover dismissal state paths
what: Uses NSPopover detach so the main panel can be dragged off the menu bar and stays open through outside clicks, Esc and icon clicks.

title: fix(screenshot): honor filename patterns when copying captures
risk: medium: shared copy and save numbering can advance twice
what: Applies the configured filename pattern and %# numbering to copied screenshots, sharing helpers with the save path and rolling numbers back on failure.

title: feat(display): add native DisplayLink brightness and remove software dimming
risk: high: DisplayLink integration and removal of a fallback path
what: Adds native brightness for DisplayLink virtual displays via distributed notifications and removes the gamma/software-dimming fallback and its UI.

title: feat(monitor): add total and used memory style
what: Adds a Total / Used memory style showing both values on two lines to two decimal places, localized, with the settings preview updated.

title: feat(scratchpad): search the pad with command-f
risk: low: AppKit NSTextFinder in a non-activating panel
what: Maps cmd-F and cmd-G to NSTextFinder actions in the floating Scratchpad, opening the native find bar with live highlight and Escape closing it first.

title: feat(window-layout): add make larger and make smaller actions
risk: low: reuses existing AX window resize paths
what: Adds two window actions that grow or shrink the active window by 10 pt per edge around its centre, with visible-frame clamping, restore, and settings, menu and command-bar entries.

title: feat(audio): confirm the new output after switching sound devices
risk: low: shares new transient OSD panel, no private APIs
what: Adds optional notices naming the newly selected output device, routed through the island or a centred popup, plus an alert sound when cycling outputs by shortcut.

title: feat(ocr): toggle line breaks from the copy confirmation
risk: low: overlay UI over existing capture model
what: Adds Cut Breaks / Add Breaks to the OCR copy confirmation, flipping the Remove line breaks setting and re-copying the same capture without re-running recognition.

title: feat(sound): add key sounds with accelerometer velocity
risk: high: undocumented SPU sensor, unclear sample licensing, 20MB assets
what: Adds an opt-in Key Sounds feature playing mechanical keyboard packs through AVAudioEngine, scaling sample velocity from the MacBook SPU accelerometer where available.

title: feat(notch): hide Controls tiles already pinned around the island
risk: low: island layout and settings only
what: Adds an on-by-default switch that drops Controls tiles whose section or control is already pinned as a button around the island, dimming those cards in settings.

title: feat(command-bar): emoji grid with tile sizes and its own global shortcut
what: Turns the emoji category into a resizable tile grid with two-dimensional arrow navigation, and adds a global shortcut that takes over a macOS key only after consent.

title: feat(mouse): add an only-between-displays option to focus follows mouse
risk: low: reuses the existing window list query
what: Adds an off-by-default option so hover moves focus only when the pointer settles on a window on a different display, comparing displays before any Accessibility lookup.

title: fix(backlight): enable key repeat for keyboard backlight shortcuts
risk: low: touches same brightness tap as #2595
what: Routes configurable keyboard brightness shortcuts through the existing CGEvent tap so macOS autorepeat dims continuously, keeping Carbon hotkeys as a single-press fallback.

title: feat(agents): add Google Antigravity support to Dynamic Island
risk: medium: undocumented transcript format, spawns agy polling
what: Adds Antigravity as an agent provider: transcript discovery under ~/.gemini, measured token and cost parsing, and a version-gated agy usage poller for account limits.

title: feat(localization): add Thai (th) language support
risk: low: strings only, draft translation quality
what: Adds complete Thai localization: 1,043 core strings, all 62 feature string catalogs, and Thai permission descriptions, registered in the language list and tests.

title: feat(keep-awake): end the session when the battery gets hot
risk: medium: extra SMC connection and temperature keys
what: Adds a 35 to 50 degree thermal limit beside the charge cutoff that ends Keep Awake sessions and blocks automatic starts when the battery is hot, on wall power too.

title: fix(keep-awake): stop caching a stale external-display reading
risk: low: one predicate plus dead property removal
what: Makes a failed display enumeration read as not connected instead of reusing a cached true, fixing sessions that kept the Mac awake for hours after unplugging a monitor.

title: feat(screen-capture): upload captures to server
risk: medium: network egress and header secrets in preferences
what: Adds opt-in HTTPS upload of screenshots and recordings to a self-configured endpoint with custom headers and query parameters, extracting a link from the reply.

title: fix(notch): keep claude working while background tasks run
risk: low: log parsing only, no new permissions
what: Tracks background task launches and their completion notices so the agent turn stays open, and the finish notice fires once, until all spawned work reports back.

title: fix(agents): end the turn on a local command's system output line
risk: low: parser-only change with transcript replay
what: Lets system local_command transcript lines reach the end-of-turn check, so sessions last running /clear or other slash commands stop showing as working.

title: feat(fast-reader): speed-read the current selection
risk: medium: new island page breaks gallery layout
what: Adds an opt-in rapid serial visual presentation reader for selected text, launched from Services or an Accessibility shortcut and shown in a floating window or a sixteenth island page.

title: feat(notch): draw Claude's mark from its vector
what: Replaces the borrowed Claude.app tray bitmap with a template NSImage built from Simple Icons path data, so the mark stays sharp without Claude.app installed.

title: feat: add Polish
risk: low: strings only, leftover PR template text
what: Adds full Polish localization across the core catalog and 62 feature catalogs, Polish permission descriptions, OCR language pairing and Polish count agreement.

title: fix(notch): open the playing browser and tab from the Now Playing cover
risk: high: walks AX trees and sends browser keystrokes
what: Resolves media helper processes to their owning browser and, after activation, selects the tab playing the track via Accessibility tab press or a Firefox-family keystroke fallback.

title: feat(notch): identify output-only audio sources
risk: medium: Core Audio HAL listeners, no audio sampling
what: Uses Core Audio process output state to present apps that play audio without Now Playing metadata, showing name, icon, selection and removal when output stops.

title: fix(notch): synchronize Spotify playback and covers
risk: high: Spotify scripting interface and CDN artwork fetches
what: Reads Spotify through its scripting interface for accurate track state and command validation, and fetches its reported artwork, rejecting mixed-track snapshots and stale covers.

title: feat(menu-bar): hide menu bar icons behind a divider
risk: high: undocumented divider limits, event tap, Accessibility
what: Adds opt-in menu bar icon hiding by growing a divider on macOS 14 to 26 or claiming the system overflow chevron on macOS 27, with timed re-hide.

title: feat(scratchpad): add direct rename and export actions
risk: low: toolbar space at narrow widths unverified
what: Adds Rename and Export buttons beside formatting in both scratchpad views and a double-click on a tab title to open its rename dialog.

title: feat(launchpad): Launchpad Classic, a full-screen app grid
risk: medium: MultitouchSupport bridge and new full-screen panel
what: Adds an opt-in paged, searchable full-screen app grid with folders, drag reorder, keyboard navigation and four-finger pinch open, restoring the removed macOS Launchpad.

title: fix(notch): wait 50 ms before the closed island grows under the pointer
risk: low: hover timing in the island
what: Waits 50 ms before the closed island grows under the pointer, cancelling if the pointer has left, so crossing the notch no longer flickers.

title: feat(fan-control): hold a manual speed for a chosen time
risk: medium: wall-clock state around the XPC helper
what: Adds duration chips from 5 minutes to 1 hour, or until changed, to manual fan control, with live countdown, early stop and return to System at expiry.

title: fix(focus): stop hover pulling focus back after a keyboard app switch
risk: low: workspace notifications and hover state only
what: Discards pointer movement recorded before an activation hover did not request, so Command-Tab stops bouncing focus back to the window under the pointer.

title: feat(quit-protection): guard the lock screen shortcut and the Touch ID button
risk: high: undocumented subtype-16 events and SMC bHLD key
what: Adds opt-in hold or double-press confirmation for the lock screen shortcut and a configurable long-press guard for the Touch ID power button.

title: feat(notch): add tokens and skills cards to the AI agents page
what: Adds optional cards showing per-agent token rings split by kind and per-period skill invocation counts, plus per-model and per-project token rings.

title: feat(shortcuts): add Shortcuts actions for toggles, Keep Awake, mixer and timer
risk: medium: metadata needs Xcode and Team ID signing
what: Adds nine App Intents behind an off-by-default switch so Shortcuts can toggle features, hold Keep Awake, set app volume and drive timers.

title: feat(notch): music inactivity pause timeout and foreground player suppression
risk: low: uses existing music service and app observation
what: Adds a configurable 0 to 10 second delay before a paused music capsule dismisses and an option to suppress the capsule while the player app is frontmost.

title: fix(notch): keep lock screen dynamic island panel flush with notch bezel
what: Overrides constrainFrameRect on the lock screen island panel and adds 8 pt top bleed so the capsule hugs the camera housing instead of sitting below the menu bar.

title: feat: show external SSD SMART temperature in menu bar
risk: medium: SMART reads through IOKit, device dependent
what: Adds an opt-in disk temperature metric preferring an external SMART-capable drive with fallback to other SMART disks, reusing existing temperature formatting.

title: feat(notch): lower lock screen music player widget above login controls
risk: low: layout constants and one test
what: Reduces login clearance from 250 to 190 points and bottom-aligns the lock screen music player so it rests above the avatar and password prompt.

title: feat(panel): island pages accessible from the menu panel
risk: medium: broad service lifecycle refactor across six features
what: Makes Agents, Calendar, Timer, Downloads, Notifications and Now Playing usable from the menu panel without the island, with settings pages, demand-based services and a menu bar agent reading.

title: feat(quick-tools): add gemini live voice chat and screen sharing
risk: high: microphone, screen capture, cloud upload, Keychain keys
what: Adds opt-in Gemini Live voice conversation from the notch or menu bar using a personal API key, with optional screen sharing and full teardown on stop, sleep or lock.

title: feat(notch): choose which agent the closed island shows a limit for
risk: low: preference plus island reading selection
what: Adds a Limit from menu (Working agent, Claude, Codex) so a pinned agent's usage limit shows beside the camera and on the resting wings regardless of who is working.

title: feat(notch): make level percentages optional

title: feat(camera-preview): add an optional microphone ring
risk: medium: microphone permission and capture session restart

title: feat(window-maximizer): apply the shared screen gap
risk: medium: AX frame settling and supersession state machine

title: feat(monitor): add a high-charge reminder
risk: low: reuses IOPS observer and notification path
what: Adds an off-by-default reminder firing once per charging session when charge crosses a 60 to 100 percent threshold, re-arming on unplug, five-point drop, relaunch or re-enable.

title: feat(notch): answer Claude Code and Codex approvals from the Dynamic Island
risk: high: writes agent settings.json hooks and socket relay

title: feat(notch): show every Claude and Codex session on the AI page

what: Adds opt-in instant desktop switching via keyboard shortcuts and trackpad swipes, requiring Accessibility, with licensed Space Rabbit gesture code.

title: feat(notch): show the island in Mission Control and on the screen saver
risk: medium: Mission Control and screen saver scene state
what: Adds opt-in switches to keep the island visible in Mission Control and to show the lock-screen view over a locked screen saver.

title: feat(notch): add a toggle for the artwork accent
what: Adds a default-on preference turning off artwork-derived accent colors, making playback controls white across island surfaces.

title: build: build for the host architecture instead of hardcoding arm64
what: Makes build.sh follow the host architecture with a VORSsAINT_ARCH override and documents Intel as unofficial build-it-yourself, warning CPU temperature is unavailable.

title: ci: build and test on an intel runner
what: Adds a draft intel job to ci.yml running build, selftest and tests on an Intel runner, stacked on #2674.

title: feat(localization): add Polish support for v3.4.2
what: Adds a machine-assisted Polish localization draft against v3.4.2, updating 93 entries across feature catalogs, permissions and bundles.

title: feat(cleaner): offer the npx and Bun package caches
what: Adds npx and Bun cache folders to the cleaner's Developer junk paths, reusing the existing selection and removal checks.

title: feat(environment): add a read-only PATH diagnostic page
what: Adds a read-only Command Environment page comparing terminal and app PATH, showing winning binaries, versions and shadows, with a copyable report.

title: feat(notch): automate pomodoro phases and media playback
risk: medium: MediaRemote private API, playback control
what: Adds default-off Pomodoro options to auto-advance focus and break phases and pause or resume the system media session around timer phases.

title: fix(monitor): preserve commas in network process names
what: Fixes the nettop parser so process names containing commas are kept, reading byte counters from the end of each CSV row.

title: feat(brightness): automatically disable the built-in display when docked
what: Adds an opt-in setting to disconnect the built-in display while a physical external monitor is connected, restoring it on undock, wake and preference changes.

title: feat(window-layout): toggle Finder with one hotkey
what: Adds a global shortcut and command bar action that toggles Finder's visibility, hiding it when frontmost.

title: feat(cleaner): route received files from any configured app
risk: medium: automated file moves with undo
what: Generalizes the download organizer to route files from any configured app list with extension filters, consolidating routing and undo rules.

title: feat(quick-tools): add pointer hide, dock delay skip, and hot corner cycling
risk: medium: Dock preference writes, pointer hiding
what: Adds quick-toggle rows to hide the idle pointer, skip the Dock reveal delay, and cycle hot corner configurations.

title: feat(window-layout): hide and restore all windows from one hotkey
what: Adds hotkeys to hide all windows and unminimize all windows across apps, running the accessibility sweep off the main thread.

title: feat(mixer): mute mic while typing, cycle input, and mute system sound
risk: medium: audio HAL writes, global hotkeys
what: Adds mute-mic-while-typing, audio input device cycling, a system mute hotkey and a post-wake volume cap.

title: feat(url-cleaner): import ClearURLs rules as a layer under your own
risk: low: opt-in rules import, bounded file read
what: Imports ClearURLs rules as a separate layer under built-in and user rules, with preview counts, refusal reasons and an imported label.

title: feat(clipboard): filter the shelf by text, link, code, image or file
what: Adds tabs and counts filtering clipboard shelf entries by text, link, code, image or file, computed and cached at draw time.

title: feat(metrics): read Intel Mac CPU and GPU temperatures
risk: medium: SMC sensor keys, Intel-only paths
what: Adds Intel CPU core, package and GPU SMC temperature reading to sensor discovery, the monitor, fan control and selftest.

title: feat(mixer): let the panel drive more than one output at a time
risk: medium: audio device routing and persistence
what: Lets the mixer panel show multiple system volume sliders, each bound to its own output, with a display-aware count cap.

title: feat(menu-bar): add native Menu Bar Hider
risk: medium: status item placement, optional Accessibility
what: Adds a native Menu Bar Hider using its own status items as separators, with an always-hidden section, click, shortcut, scroll or hover reveal, and auto-collapse.

title: feat(keyboard): add configurable key and shortcut remaps
risk: high: HID remapping, event taps, Accessibility
what: Adds opt-in keyboard remaps with key and shortcut rules, five presets, HID mapping, Accessibility event taps, conflict detection and full localization.

title: feat(agents): show T3 Code activity in Dynamic Island
risk: medium: Keychain tokens, remote HTTPS endpoints
what: Adds read-only T3 Code thread activity to AI Agents, pairing local or remote environments with Keychain tokens and orchestration:read scope.

title: feat(notch): like the playing song on Spotify from the island
risk: medium: OAuth loopback listener, token storage
what: Adds a Spotify like and unlike heart to the island's music page using a user-registered Spotify developer app, OAuth PKCE and library endpoints.

title: feat(brightness): add extra dimming for the built-in display
risk: medium: gamma overlay dimming, key tap
what: Adds Extra dimming for the built-in display below the lowest backlight step, with backlight and picture floors and adjusted brightness-key handling.

title: l10n: complete Swedish localization
what: Completes Swedish translations across feature catalogs, onboarding, permissions, settings and macOS flows, replacing English fallback text.

title: feat(notch): hide or show desktop icons from the island's controls
what: Adds a Desktop icons tile to the island's Controls page reusing the existing quick toggle, hidden by default.

title: feat(settings): unify feature categories and visibility views
risk: high: broad settings refactor, defaults migration
what: Overhauls Settings feature categories with Focused, Expanded and Everything visibility filters, inclusion controls, Turn on actions and preference-level Undo/Redo.

title: feat(displays): turn off the built-in display at launch beside a monitor
risk: medium: external display detection at launch
what: Adds an opt-in option to turn off the built-in display at launch when an external monitor is connected, acting once per launch.

title: feat(mouse-buttons): map the Logitech gesture button chord
risk: low: event tap mask, new sentinel
what: Maps the Logitech MX gesture button's Control-Option-Tab chord as a mouse button shortcut, consuming the press and swallowing releases.

title: feat(agents): read DeepSeek Harness sessions
risk: medium: new log format, pricing model
what: Adds DeepSeek Harness as a fifth AI agent, reading its JSON session projections for turns, tokens, models and off-peak pricing.

title: feat(notch): draw the capsule's battery icon from the charge
what: Fixes the closed island capsule's battery icon to reflect actual charge, charging bolt and warning color through a shared glyph mapper.

title: feat(sound): add click, key and scroll sounds and a click highlight
what: Adds opt-in synthesized click, key and scroll sounds plus a click highlight ring for presentations, using a listen-only event tap.

title: feat(browser-picker): choose the browser or profile for each link
risk: high: default browser role, Full Disk Access
what: Adds an optional default-browser picker with per-site rules and Chrome or Firefox profile routing, reading browser profile databases.

title: fix(command-bar): open a saved host and port link as a site
what: Fixes command bar link opening for host:port destinations like localhost:3000 by treating digits after a colon as a port.

title: fix(metrics): pick byte units and decimals from the rounded value
what: Fixes metric byte formatters to choose unit and decimals from the rounded value, so boundaries print 1.0 TB instead of 1000 GB.

title: feat(notch): add native Apple Music lyrics and TTML support
risk: high: private Apple lyric endpoints, scraped tokens
what: Adds an experimental Apple Music lyrics provider with TTML rendering and local LRC, TTML or XML import, using private lyric endpoints and MusicKit tokens.

title: feat(notch): heart for Apple Music and Spotify, and Spotify's Up next
risk: medium: Music scripting, Spotify OAuth reuse
what: Adds a heart for Apple Music favorites and Spotify liked songs plus Spotify's Up next queue, building on the Spotify work in #2750.

title: feat(fans): add adaptive fan control
risk: high: SMC fan writes, privileged helper
what: Adds an Adaptive fan mode following CPU temperature along a two-threshold curve with presets, smoothing and a resume retry fix.

title: feat(command-bar): consolidate system appearance toggle title
what: Replaces the command bar's dynamic appearance toggle title with a static one, keeping light and dark as search keywords.

title: feat(dock-preview): arrange a run by dragging its cards
what: Lets users reorder a Dock preview's window cards by dragging within the panel, with session state held per app run.

title: feat(wallpaper): dynamic appearance wallpaper management with light and dark slots
what: Adds light and dark wallpaper slots with automatic switching on appearance change and wake, gallery badges and a Quick Tools toggle.

title: feat(agents): follow Pi and Oh My Pi sessions
risk: medium: new session formats, cost fallback
what: Adds Pi and Oh My Pi session tracking to AI Agents with independent toggles, auxiliary usage handling and archived cost persistence.

title: feat(menu-bar): stack two fan speeds
what: Adds an option to stack the two fan speeds vertically in the menu bar's fan tile, matching the network block.

title: feat(command-bar): recover queries typed with another keyboard layout
what: Recovers command bar queries typed in the wrong keyboard layout by mapping physical keys through enabled macOS layouts.

title: feat(agents): add Cursor meter, waiting rings and per-agent spend
risk: medium: reads local transcripts and plan usage
what: Adds Cursor as an AI agent plus working and waiting meter rings, hover detail, sign-in prompts, per-agent spend and an optional edge meter.

title: feat(home-assistant): add home assistant controls to dynamic island
what: Adds an optional Home Assistant integration to the island with WebSocket connection, Keychain tokens, paged entity cards, toggles, brightness and color control.

title: feat(quicktools): add continuity camera capture with auto-paste to cursor
what: Adds Continuity Camera capture from Quick Tools with a global shortcut and optional automatic paste at the cursor.

title: feat(screen-capture): add a QR result action preference
what: Adds a QR code action preference choosing between result popup, copying content, or opening the link directly across all QR entry points.

title: fix(notch): accept scroll gestures at the physical notch’s top edge
what: Forwards top-edge scroll gestures on physically notched displays to the island gesture handler so they can open it.

title: Refactor NotchMediaPresentationProbe for clarity
what: Titled as a clarity refactor of NotchMediaPresentationProbe, but the description is the empty PR template with no details or verification.

title: feat(radial-menu): run shortcuts and scripts from the wheel
risk: medium: runs user scripts and shortcuts
what: Adds radial menu actions to run a Shortcuts app shortcut by identifier or execute a chosen script, with strings for 15 languages.

title: feat(settings): use primary colors for sidebar icons
what: Changes normal Settings sidebar icons from the accent tint to the system primary color so dense lists stay readable, removing the selection-based tint calculation.

title: feat(utilities): set the default app for file formats
what: Adds a Default Apps settings page that reads an app's declared document types and sets it as handler for chosen extensions via NSWorkspace, one confirmation each.

title: feat(features): block chosen apps from opening
what: Generalizes the Music-only block into a list of apps that are asked to quit on launch, with system-app and path guards and a moved settings page.

title: feat(network): show total data usage since boot in the network monitor
what: Adds a persisted accumulator of per-interface download and upload deltas with menu bar and detail rows plus localization and tests.

title: feat(mouse): add independent trackpad scroll reversal
risk: medium: private HID bridge, event taps
what: Splits mouse scrolling into four device/axis reversal settings, adding trackpad vertical and horizontal controls with HID-bridge fallback to Quartz reversal.

title: feat(bluetooth): disconnect selected devices on sleep
risk: medium: Bluetooth API calls, permission plists
what: Adds a selected-device mode to Bluetooth-on-sleep that disconnects only checked paired devices while leaving radio power and wake behavior untouched.

title: feat(menu-bar): add the Menu Bar Organizer for macOS 27
risk: high: private MenuBarClientCore framework, HID drags
what: Adds a Bartender-style status item organizer with collapse icon, three visibility tiers, reordering, a shelf mode, and Arabic support via #2992.

title: feat(monitor): reverse the menu bar item with one click
what: Adds a Reverse order button that flips metric order and moves the app icon to the other end of the combined menu bar item.

title: feat(dock): add opt-in dock and window enhancements
risk: high: huge scope, capture permissions, GPL-derived code
what: Mega-PR adding DockDoor-like features: active-app indicators, display locking, richer previews, widgets, gestures, switcher navigation and a scripting window API.

title: feat(i18n): add Arabic catalogs and native RTL navigation
risk: medium: touches many views, needs native review
what: Adds Arabic string catalogs, locale registration, live reading-direction updates and mirrored navigation fixes, as an alternative to another Arabic proposal.

title: feat(menu-bar): add an experimental icon organizer
what: Draft alternative organizer with hidden and always-hidden sections, a horizontal icon shelf and a staged private-API visibility backend.

title: feat(notch): add AI Accounts to the Dynamic Island
risk: high: rewrites Keychain and Claude credentials
what: Adds an island section that stores several Claude/Codex logins, shows their usage limits, swaps the active login and can auto-swap near limits.

title: feat(keep-awake): wait for ai agents to finish
what: Adds an island and panel Keep Awake mode that holds the Mac awake until agent turns go quiet, optionally following one task and shutting down after.

title: feat(notch): announce when an agent waits for input
what: Watches a Claude Code distributed notification so the closed island announces questions and permission prompts, with an optional sound alerts switch.

title: feat(notch): let the companion wear an animated face character
risk: medium: runs external codex CLI, new asset loader
what: Adds a Character companion style loading animated face packs from disk, plus a Settings generator that drives Codex image generation through a bundled skill.

title: feat(menu-bar): offer the battery as a vertical bar in the bars appearance
what: Adds an opt-in icon/bar battery display under the bars appearance, drawing charge through the usage-bar path with reversed colors and a charging bolt.

title: feat(trackpad): map multi-finger gestures to actions
risk: medium: MultitouchSupport private bridge, gesture conflicts
what: Adds an opt-in feature mapping three-to-five-finger taps, swipes and pinches to actions, with per-gesture settings, system-gesture warnings and app exceptions.

title: feat(files): add optional duplicate file finder
risk: medium: mass Trash moves on user files
what: Adds a draft duplicate finder that hashes candidate files, previews copies, and moves user-selected duplicates to the Trash with per-group keeper safety checks.

title: feat(notch): keep the charge level under the resting battery's bolt
what: Replaces fixed-step SF Symbol battery glyphs with a custom drawn icon filling to the exact percentage and showing Apple's bolt while on the adapter.

title: feat(combo-mode): open apps by typing a key sequence after a trigger
what: Adds an opt-in leader-key overlay where a global shortcut opens a panel and grouped key sequences launch apps, placeable centered, in the island or as a chip.

title: fix(command-bar): run picks after the droplet close finishes
risk: low: timing change, no new privileges
what: Defers app activation until the command bar droplet retract completes, and skips a redundant canvas layout, removing a Stage Manager stutter.

title: feat(agents): add Antigravity CLI to AI Agents
risk: medium: parses private logs, shells out to agy
what: Adds Google Antigravity CLI as a fifth agent, reading SQLite conversation logs for tokens and querying agy usage, plus a reworked five-agent spending layout.

title: feat(agents): open the Now card into a list of every agent at work
what: Makes the Now card tappable to show a full scrolling list of all running agent turns, view-only with no new preferences or strings.

title: feat(energy): add a sleep and shutdown timer
risk: medium: System Events automation, real shutdown
what: Adds an opt-in timer that sleeps or normally shuts down the Mac after a duration or clock time, holding a sleep assertion and confirming shutdown consent.

title: feat(notch): send Files to AirDrop in one click
what: Adds an AirDrop button beside Share on the island Files page, sending the selection or whole shelf through NSSharingService with no new strings.

title: feat(notch): show system readings in the expanded header, as an option
what: Adds an off-by-default header readout of battery, CPU, GPU and memory that yields to header actions on hover and samples only while open.

title: feat(notch): add an optional Home page with smart cards
risk: low: new island page and paging views
what: Adds an optional Home island page whose cards swipe between player, AI agents, levels, calendar and files faces, ordered by what matters now.

title: feat(utilities): switch the default web browser from settings
what: Adds a Default Browser tool listing installed browsers with Make Default buttons, reading and writing Launch Services http/https handlers with no stored state.

title: feat(utilities): switch to the next default browser with a shortcut
risk: low: Launch Services changes, stacked on #3061
what: Builds on #3061 to add a global shortcut cycling the default browser, per-row selection checkboxes, a panel tile and an island confirmation notice.

title: feat(notch): Adjust menu bar size and make it black
what: Claims to make the macOS menu bar black and change its height, with no implementation detail, design discussion or test evidence in the description.

title: feat(disk-analyzer): map disk space as an interactive sunburst
risk: medium: Full Disk Access, batch Trash moves
what: Adds an opt-in disk analyzer scanning volumes in parallel and showing a zoomable sunburst with lists, rebuildable-folder suggestions, marking, Trash and undo.

title: feat(window-layout): restore snapped windows dragged away from their placement
risk: medium: Accessibility frame writes, AX flag deferral
what: Gives a tiled window back its previous size when dragged away while still parked, capped to the display, for both title-bar and modifier drags.

title: feat: add customizable Touch Bar controls for supported MacBooks
risk: medium: dead hardware, IOKit detection, untested suite
what: Adds opt-in NSTouchBar controls (keep awake, mic mute, clipboard, CPU/RAM, launcher) shown while the app panel is active on Touch Bar MacBooks.

title: feat(brightness): let the brightness keys adjust all displays
risk: medium: key tap, DDC and gamma stepping
what: Adds an opt-in mode where a brightness key press moves every active display together, preserving each display's offset including at range limits.

title: feat(agents): show a local agent tree card on the AI Agents page
risk: low: reads one optional local file
what: Adds an optional card reading a third-party Agent Tree JSON snapshot to show which subagents ran under the current thread with tokens and cost.

title: feat(auto-quit): add allowlist mode to quit on close
what: Adds a mode picker so Quit on close can quit only listed apps instead of everything except exceptions, with separate lists and Finder protection.

title: feat(selection-bar): show actions next to selected text
risk: medium: Accessibility reads, synthetic copy shortcut
what: Adds an optional bar appearing beside text selected in other apps offering Copy plus command bar tools, reading selection via Accessibility and closing quickly.

title: feat(screenshot): add curved arrows and richer annotation tools
risk: low: pure drawing and export code
what: Extends the screenshot editor with bendable quadratic arrows, magnifier, ruler, shape fills, constrained drawing, hand-drawn marker ink and custom colors.

title: feat(notch): add named Spaces and shared display controls
risk: medium: posts system shortcuts, display topology
what: Adds a named Spaces switcher to the island using Mission Control shortcuts, with rename support and an option to show Spaces from all displays.

title: feat(monitor): add configurable agent readouts to the menu bar
what: Pins Claude, Codex, OpenCode or Copilot usage, tokens or quota beside CPU and RAM in the menu bar, fully configurable per agent.

title: fix(cleaning-mode): optionally cover only the built-in display
what: Adds an off-by-default preference limiting Cleaning Mode overlays to the built-in display, falling back to all displays when none is present.

title: feat(notch): show calendar event descriptions
what: Shows event descriptions on the island calendar page with a hide setting, expand control only when truncated, and localized labels.

title: feat(media): convert audio and video files to MP3
risk: medium: large custom encoder, LGPL-derived tables
what: Adds a Media Audio tab and a self-contained MPEG-1 Layer III encoder so any audio or video file can be saved as a bitrate-chosen MP3.

title: feat(quick-tools): add push-to-talk on-device voice typing
risk: medium: speech permission, global hotkey, audio engine
what: Adds an optional Quick Tools utility that dictates while a shortcut is held, inserts the transcript into the frontmost app, and shows a listening pill.

title: feat(agents): show and use Claude's banked resets in the island
risk: high: reads Claude credentials, posts to claude.ai
what: Queries claude.ai with Claude Code's own token to show banked limit resets and lets the user spend one, with confirmation and retry-safe request ids.

title: feat(monitor): support intel macs with universal builds
risk: medium: build matrix, Intel sensor mapping
what: Makes release builds universal, adds an x86_64 slice to helper binaries, and classifies Intel temperature sensor keys for monitor and fan control.

title: test(runner): reset shared defaults between test groups
what: Restores the registration domain and clears the test preferences domain after each test group, fixing fifteen cross-suite migration failures, plus a flaky scroll wait.

title: feat(herdr): show supervised agent status in menu bar and notch
risk: medium: external CLI, unverified live, English-only strings
what: Polls the external herdr CLI to show supervised agent status in a panel row and island module with a blocked-agent badge.

title: feat(display): add flexible HiDPI scaling for external displays
risk: high: root-owned overrides, admin prompt, display cycling
what: Writes display override plists to let macOS expose every HiDPI size of an external monitor, cycling the display to reload, with admin prompts and uninstall cleanup.

title: Feat/hdr toggle
risk: high: SkyLight private symbols, HDR display effects
what: Adds a per-display HDR switch using SkyLight symbols and lets extra brightness boost external HDR displays, with the slider and overlay reading past 100%.

title: feat(window-layout): set the screen gap per edge
risk: low: geometry math and new defaults
what: Adds optional per-edge top, bottom, left and right gap overrides that fall back to the existing single screen gap value.

title: feat(finder): add configurable file and document tools
risk: high: extension signing, camera/mic capture, incomplete parity
what: Draft Finder Sync extension and workspace offering ~85 file, archive, image, PDF and system actions from a configurable Finder context menu.

title: feat(agents): track Muse usage and live work
risk: low: reads local session logs only
what: Adds Meta's Muse CLI as an agent, parsing session JSONL logs for tokens, cache share, turns and subagent usage with privacy-limited metadata reads.

title: Color volume blue and brightness beige in the island
what: Tints island volume feedback blue and brightness feedback beige across notices, header readout, control sliders and the mixer fader.

title: docs(permissions): send readers to Advanced, not About
what: Corrects one sentence in the permissions documentation so the permission reset is said to be under Advanced rather than About.

title: feat(agents): follow Kiro usage and monthly credits
risk: medium: spawns kiro-cli ACP server for usage
what: Adds Kiro CLI as an agent reading session logs for credits and turns, and queries Kiro's ACP server for monthly plan allowance and overage.

title: feat(menu-bar): offer an icon-only battery with proportional charge fill
what: Adds an optional hide-percentage mode with a proportionally filled battery icon, charging bolt or paused plug, and a larger glyph when text is hidden.

title: fix(notch): keep the macOS volume banner away for AirPods volume changes
what: Watches MenuBarAgent via Accessibility and moves the duplicated volume popup off screen while the island shows a Bluetooth volume change.

title: feat(notch): open calendar events in fantastical
what: Adds an Open events in picker, shown when Fantastical is installed, so island calendar events and the Open Calendar button use Fantastical's URL scheme.

title: feat(notch): join zoom, meet and teams calls from the island
what: Adds Join buttons and a closed-island icon for Zoom/Meet/Teams links found in calendar events, opening Zoom via zoommtg:// and other links in the browser.

title: feat(screenshot): copy to clipboard on thumbnail click in quick preview
what: Title says a quick-preview thumbnail click copies the screenshot to the clipboard; the description is an unfilled PR template with no summary or verification.

title: feat(notch): chat with Claude, Cursor or Codex from the companion
risk: high: spawns AI CLIs; credentials and prompts
what: Adds an in-island chat that runs the installed claude, agent or Codex CLI read-only, with setup checks, provider switching, settings status and localization (draft).

title: feat(agents): add weekly quota planning cards
what: Adds a Weekly usage card for Claude and Codex showing observed quota, ideal and recalibrated plan lines, and weekday targets stored locally.

title: feat(keep-awake): start a session while AI agents work
risk: medium: keeps Mac awake; reads agent logs
what: Adds an AI Agents condition to Keep Awake automation that holds a session while followed agents work, plus a configurable grace period afterwards.

title: feat(display): switch appearance with ambient light
risk: high: private IOKit sensor and SkyLight APIs
what: Adds an opt-in ambient-light appearance switch using the built-in sensor with ten lux presets, a live meter and a four-second dwell (draft).

title: feat(agents): count every Claude Code profile folder
risk: medium: multiple config dirs; control requests
what: Discovers ~/.claude-* profile folders, adds each profile's logs to spend totals, gives each profile a limits card and per-profile opt-out switches.

title: feat(dock-preview): optionally open only for apps with more than one window
what: Adds an optional Dock Preview setting to open only for apps with more than one window, and stops declined hovers from re-reading windows repeatedly.

title: feat(menu-bar): optionally open a metric's details from the combined item
risk: medium: custom hit-testing on status item

title: feat(window-pinning): keep any window floating above the rest

title: feat(always-on-top): keep a pinned window in view above other apps
what: Adds an alternative Always On Top feature that mirrors a pinned window via ScreenCaptureKit, with hover/click reveal, border settings and permission handling.

title: feat(window-pinning): add show on all spaces
what: Stacked on #3248: adds a Show on All Spaces option so a pinned window's live clone follows the user across Spaces.

title: feat(window-layout): show per-display tile zones while holding Option
risk: medium: input tap and Accessibility window access
what: Adds an opt-in Option-key tile-zone overlay to Window Layout with independent per-display layouts saved by display UUID and editable zone boundaries.

title: feat: add Hermes agent support to the notch AI tracker
risk: medium: third-party SQLite schema; new provider

title: fix(notch): show the island on the menu bar display when automatic

title: feat(notch): add compact lyrics below Dynamic Island with liquid glass surface
what: Adds a compact three-line synchronized lyrics panel below the Dynamic Island with a glass background, toggle, one-click dismissal and localization.

title: feat(radial-menu): show clipboard history and folder contents beside the wheel
risk: medium: pasteboard, folder access, drag sessions

risk: medium: speech recognition; local network server

title: feat(notch): lay the calendar's week out vertically beside the agenda

title: feat(media): merge pdfs and images into one pdf
what: Adds a PDF tool to the Media workspace that merges PDFs and images in a reorderable preview list, with notch drop integration.

title: Add a local MCP control bridge
risk: high: local control server and MCP surface
what: Adds a loopback MCP control bridge and stdio server to the Developer build only, with per-launch token auth for status, feature toggles, Keep Awake and appearance (draft, untested).

title: feat(dock): add Dock tweaks with a Dock size lock
risk: medium: writes Dock defaults; restarts Dock

title: feat(screenshot): add a transparent editor backdrop
what: Adds a Transparent backdrop option to the screenshot editor that exports padded PNGs with alpha and shows a checkerboard for clear areas.

title: feat(clipboard): choose where history opens from clipboard settings

title: feat(screenshot): add separate area and window capture shortcuts
