title: feat(audio): add multi-output audio combination with per-device volume
risk: medium - aggregate device and hardware volume writes
what: Builds a native stacked CoreAudio aggregate device so system and app audio play through several outputs at once, with per-device volume, mute and master stepping.

title: feat(clipboard): add anchored range selection and inversion
risk: medium - selection model rewrite across two surfaces
what: Adds Shift+arrow anchored range selection and Command+Shift inversion to clipboard history in both the window and island, with a shared mouse/keyboard selection model.

title: feat(agents): add an all-time usage period
risk: medium - unbounded history raises load time and memory
what: Adds an All time period reading all available local agent logs, removing the 91-day reading cap and rebuilding caches when older history appears.

title: feat(agents): add custom date ranges
what: Adds a Custom range period with native date pickers for agent spending and token stats, persisting ISO dates and reusing the summary cache.

title: feat(cleaner): add large files, duplicates and startup items tools
risk: medium - bulk file removal guarded by Trash and rechecks
what: Adds Cleaner tools for large files, content duplicates and startup items in dedicated windows, with safety labels and Trash-only removal after re-verification.

title: feat(cleaning): add a global shortcut to toggle cleaning mode
what: Adds an opt-in global shortcut (default Control-Option-Command-B) that starts Cleaning Mode from anywhere, reusing the quick-tool hotkey pattern.

title: fix(keep-awake): tint the island indicator with the chosen icon tint
what: Fixes the notch keep-awake strip indicator to follow the user's chosen icon tint instead of hardcoded yellow, sharing one tint mapping with the menu bar.

title: feat(switcher): add an option to mix windowless apps into the list
what: Adds an off-by-default setting that removes the No Open Windows divider so windowless apps appear inline in recent-activation order like native Command-Tab.

title: feat(screenshot): add tiled watermarks to the editor
what: Adds a Single/Full image watermark layout that repeats the mark across the editable canvas, saved with settings and presets, including expanded areas.

title: feat(notch): let the dynamic island outline take a chosen colour and width
what: Makes the island outline colour and width (1-6 pt) configurable from Settings, and fixes colour changes not reaching mirrored islands on other displays.

title: feat(Dock Preview): Add Dock Preview panel alignment options
what: Adds a Dock Preview alignment choice that anchors the preview panel near the hovered Dock icon instead of the screen edge, keeping recent windows close.

title: feat(i18n): add Dutch localization
what: Adds complete Dutch localization with language auto-selection for nl-NL and nl-BE, Dutch text recognition and localized alert sound names.

title: feat(shelf): paste files, images, links and text from the clipboard
risk: low - pasteboard reads, existing import path
what: Adds Command-V paste to the shelf drop zones and media workspace, importing clipboard files, images, links and text through the existing drop pipeline.

title: feat(clipboard): preview and edit island history entries
risk: medium - security-scoped URLs and editor plumbing
what: Adds Space-key island previews with in-place text editing and bounded PNG snapshots of security-scoped WeChat/QQ image copies so previews, OCR and editing work.

title: feat(agents): read DeepSeek Harness usage
what: Adds a DeepSeek Harness agent provider that reads a JSONL usage feed written by a companion DSH plugin, counting tokens, API value and live turns.

title: docs(github): stop the pull request template referencing issue #123
what: Changes the pull request template's Related issues example so the fix-status workflow stops matching the literal issue #123.

title: feat(energy): add sleep now for closed-lid sessions
risk: medium - pmset sleep control and power assertions
what: Adds a Sleep now button and optional shortcut that truly sleeps the Mac during closed-lid mode and resumes the session after wake.

title: feat(command-bar): find emoji by everyday words like "lol" and "pointer"
what: Adds CLDR and Slack shortcode keywords to Command Bar emoji search through a generated 67 KB table and a pinned regeneration script.

title: ci(issues): run the daily check only in this repository
what: Guards the daily issue-fix-status job on the upstream repository name so fork copies skip it instead of failing every day.

title: feat(keep-awake): sleep the display during closed-lid dimming
risk: medium - pmset and power assertion juggling
what: Puts the built-in panel to sleep during closed-lid dimming by releasing the display-sleep assertion and calling pmset displaysleepnow, skipped with external displays.

title: feat(agents): add DeepSeek Harness usage tracking
risk: medium - optional Homebrew libzstd dylib dependency
what: Adds a DeepSeek Harness provider reading native ~/.dsh v4 session logs including incrementally written zstd frames, with settings, fixtures and archive compatibility.

title: feat(i18n): check a translation against main without building
what: Adds Tools/l10n_check.py, a git-only script that compares one language catalog with main and reports build-breaking, format or typography problems before review.

title: feat(command-bar): add shortcut for app menu commands
what: Adds an optional global shortcut that opens Command Bar pre-filtered to the foreground app's menu commands, reusing existing Accessibility access.

title: Add tool that types text as key presses
risk: medium - posts synthetic key events, needs Accessibility
what: Adds a floating pad that types its text into the front app as physical key presses, for RDP/VNC clients that block clipboard sharing, with adjustable delay.

title: feat(notch): add a glass option for the closed island
what: Adds a Glass instead of black option for the resting island with transparency and frost sliders, reducing OLED ageing and following Reduce Transparency.

title: fix(scratchpad): set done tasks aside again under a closed Completed line
what: Restores finished scratchpad tasks into a collapsed Completed section with a count, in both the window and the island, instead of drawing them in place.

title: feat(notch): dim the closed island's content
what: Adds a resting brightness slider that dims closed-island icons and text, restoring full brightness on hover or open, to limit OLED burn-in.

title: feat(middle-click): add key + click as a trigger
what: Adds a second middle-click trigger that holds chosen modifier keys and clicks, working on any mouse, with the chord stripped before apps see it.

title: feat(notch): make sound level bars easier to control, with hover & pause + haptic click at 100%
risk: medium - pointer warping and per-frame event monitors
what: Improves island level-bar control with a speed curve, hover swell, frame-synced glide and a haptic pause at 100% on app faders to stop boost overshoot.

title: feat(notch): swipe the song's position bar, with hover and a smooth sweep
risk: medium - player timing heuristics, stacked on 3934
what: Makes the island song position bar swipeable and smoothly sweeping, fixing drag flicker, post-seek jump-back and the bar closing the island.

title: fix(notch): give the floating buttons the island's liquid glass
what: Renders the round buttons floating around the open island as island glass lenses instead of flat black fills, keeping solid fallbacks.

title: fix(notch): show a boosted app's full percent and a speaker that follows its level
what: Fixes boosted app percentages truncating to an ellipsis and makes the fader's speaker icon reflect its level, with orange boost and in-place mute.

title: feat(clipboard): switch recent and pinned history with tabs
what: Replaces the stacked Recent and Pinned sections in the clipboard history shortcut window with tabs, clearing selection when switching.

title: feat(settings): pick a custom accent colour under Appearance
risk: medium - accent propagation, visual result untested
what: Adds a custom accent colour setting with eleven presets and a colour well, applied through SwiftUI's accent environment at each window root.

title: Add keyboard remapping
risk: high - global key interception via event taps
what: Layer adding configurable system-wide keyboard remapping of keys or sequences to keys, text, links or app launches, with per-app scoping and a settings editor.

title: feat(settings): improve feature discovery and settings navigation
risk: medium - broad settings rewrite, survey scope creep
what: Layer redesigning Settings navigation and feature discovery with a searchable catalog, install/uninstall lifecycle controls, favorites, ordering and a recommendation survey.

title: feat(notch): expand dynamic island and command bar
risk: high - broad island rewrite and new plugin surface
what: Layer expanding the island with a plugin registry/API, Focus status, Command Bar presentation, mascot and lock-screen/gesture support plus test diagnostics.

title: Improve Quick Tools and floating panels
what: Layer improving media workspace empty states, menu-panel refresh, and drag handles that move clipboard history and recent captures between panels and the island.

title: fix(display): route brightness keys before native indicators
risk: medium - event tap location, diff includes five layers
what: Moves the brightness key event tap to the shared HID-level tap location so the island's brightness UI precedes macOS's native indicator.

title: feat(notch): keep the menu bar in full-screen apps on the notched display
risk: high - SkyLight private APIs and Accessibility walks
what: Adds an opt-in extension that shows the menu bar beside the notch in full-screen apps, hiding it during full-screen video via a shallow Accessibility check.

title: fix(notch): keep the resting outline clear of the camera housing
what: Widens the resting outlined island by its flare width so the outline sides clear the camera housing instead of hiding behind it.

title: feat(agents): show opencode go allowances in the dynamic island
risk: medium - network call with stored API key
what: Adds an OpenCode Go mode showing remaining 5-hour, weekly and monthly allowances with per-model caps, plus an optional Console API key check.

title: Browser Picker
risk: medium - link routing edge cases unverified
what: Adds a Browser Picker panel that offers visible browsers in a reorderable list for opening links, near the cursor or screen centre, with number badges.

title: feat(notch): YouTube Music up next and Listen again
what: Reads a YouTube Music page in Safari through Accessibility to show the playing queue and the home page's Listen again shelf in the island.

title: feat(clipboard): edit image files copied in Finder from history
what: Gives clipboard entries holding a single image file copied in Finder the same Edit action as image data, opening it in the screenshot editor.

title: fix(build): make clean builds finish without compiler warnings
what: Silences existing compiler warnings in BrightnessService, AppUninstaller and mixer tests by making ignored results explicit and adjusting weak var assignments.

title: Add Face Unlock and Privacy Lock (Authentication)
risk: high - password typing, camera auth, model licensing
what: Adds opt-in Face Unlock at the lock screen and a Privacy Lock for apps and files using AES-256 containers and Finder Quick Actions.
note: 安全产品方向，超出当前产品边界/高风险

title: fix(clipboard): prefer text when a copy carries rich-text siblings
what: Prefers plain text when a copy also carries RTF or HTML, so Excel range copies store as text while screenshots and browser images stay pictures.

title: feat(mouse): click with a light one-finger tap on the Magic Mouse
what: Adds opt-in tap-to-click on the Magic Mouse with side-aware primary/secondary clicks and real double clicks, using MultitouchSupport private symbols.

title: fix(switcher): hand ⌘Tab back to macOS while a game owns the display
risk: low - window list reads and gating
what: Yields the Command-Tab takeover to macOS while an app raises an exclusive full-screen window, restoring the switcher when the game leaves full screen.

title: Dim lid when keep going with lid closed
what: Terse duplicate change releasing the display-sleep assertion and running pmset displaysleepnow for closed-lid dimming, skipped with an external display.

title: fix(window-maximizer): maximize vorssaint's own windows
what: Makes Maximize windows work on Vorssaint's own windows by resolving the pressed green button through AppKit instead of the Accessibility hit test.

title: feat(window-layout): add actions that move the active window by a set distance
what: Adds four nudge actions that move the active window left, right, up or down by a configurable pixel distance, with optional shortcuts and key repeat.

title: feat(mouse): add auto clicker with screen target picker and click macros
what: Adds an opt-in Auto Clicker with configurable button, interval, repeat limit, cursor or fixed target, recorded click macros, global shortcut and Esc stop.

title: feat(display): drive the speakers of a monitor that never answers a reading
risk: medium - DDC writes on unverified hardware
what: Writes DDC speaker volume directly for monitors that accept writes but never answer reads, remembering the last level per connection path.

title: fix(agents): give the today graph one bar per real hour
what: Fixes the agents today graph to build one bar per real hour so daylight-saving days show 23 or 25 bars instead of a merged or empty one.

title: fix(notch): give the keep awake strip the chosen tint
what: Moves the keep-awake tint-to-colour mapping onto KeepAwakeIconTint so the closed-island strip matches the menu bar icon colour instead of hard-coded yellow.

title: fix(menu bar): sit the app glyph on the system baseline
what: Removes a baked-in 1 pt optical drop from the menu bar app glyph so it aligns with the baseline of neighbouring status icons.

title: fix(uninstaller): find an app's leftovers in hidden home folders
risk: medium - deletes files in hidden home dirs
what: Extends leftover scanning to hidden home folders and ~/.local/state, claiming folders only on exact bundle, group or name matches, with a deny list and path-safety checks.

title: fix(switcher): keep the search chip inside the panel and readable
what: Gives the switcher search chip a measured top inset, stronger edge and shadow, aligns it with preview cards and anchors icon-row content to the top.

title: feat(command bar): show the super key as one glyph
what: Renders the synthetic Super Key as a single diamond glyph in the command bar caption while real four-modifier chords keep printing all their caps.

title: fix(agents): explain why Claude limits stay old
what: Rewords two AI Agents strings explaining stale Claude limits when nonessential traffic is off or the Claude app paused its menu bar checks; all 15 locales.

title: feat(mission-control): window actions for right/middle click and shortcuts in Mission Control
risk: high - Accessibility event tap on system UI
what: Adds an opt-in Mission Control feature applying quit, close, minimize or hide to the tile under the pointer, plus pointer-scoped Cmd-W/Q/H/M.

title: fix(settings): keep sidebar rows from scrolling under the search field
what: Uses the fixed search header on macOS 27 as macOS 26 already did, so scrolled Settings sidebar rows stop behind and above the search pill.

title: feat(agents): add Antigravity usage, limits and live tracking for agy 1.5
risk: medium - reads agy SQLite index read-only
what: Adds Google Antigravity to AI Agents with transcript usage and pricing, subagent rollup, project names from agy's index, and agy /usage limits.

title: feat(keyboard): give the Spotlight, dictation and Do Not Disturb keys another job
risk: medium - global key tap and sleep command
what: Adds opt-in switches turning F4 into app search, F5 into mic mute and F6 into sleep through a key tap limited to those three keys.

title: feat(screenshot): copy the saved file when saving from the editor
what: Editor Save now also copies the saved annotated file when automatic copy is on, sharing one helper with the Settings toggle.

title: fix(focus): keep focus on a window opened over the hovered one
what: Stops focus-follows-mouse re-raising the hovered window over a pop-up or clicked window by tracking a settled window and the clicked window.

title: feat(keep-awake): pause pointer movement while a display is full screen
what: Adds an opt-in Keep Awake option that skips the pointer nudge while a full-screen app shows on the pointer's display.

title: Split localization catalogs by language
what: Moves English and Brazilian Portuguese strings into per-language files and adds section markers to the localization catalogs; formatting only.
note: 本地化文件重组，无产品价值

title: fix(notch): keep the island open while AirDrop is up
what: Tracks an in-flight AirDrop send in the share presenter so the island ignores clicks in AirDrop's window and closes when the send finishes.

title: feat(notch): extend timer duration to 23 hours
what: Raises the notch countdown maximum from 3 hours to 23:59:59, adds a seconds selector and expands the ruler and tests.

title: fix(notch): center and bound new track previews
what: Grows the New Track preview symmetrically up to 160 pt per side, with ellipsis and slow scrolling for long titles or artists.

title: feat(screenshot): add optional auto-pin after capture
what: Adds opt-in settings opening new regular or scrolling screenshots directly as floating, zoomable pinned images while keeping clipboard, save and shelf actions.

title: fix(middle-click): let repeated presses through when taps are off
what: Applies the middle-click repeat guard only when tap-to-middle-click is on, so quick repeated three-finger presses no longer get swallowed.

title: fix(camera-preview): stop cropping the camera image
what: Switches the camera preview from resizeAspectFill to resizeAspect so wide external or Continuity cameras are letterboxed instead of cropped at the sides.

title: fix(switcher): let icon-row previews grow with large preview sizes
risk: medium - layout math across four layouts
what: Icon-row preview cards now follow the chosen preview size instead of the 1.15 icon cap, shrinking only as far as the screen requires.

title: feat(agents): follow Oh My Pi sessions
risk: low - reads local omp logs read-only
what: Adds an Oh My Pi (omp) reader for AI Agents: live turns, token usage and API value, subagent rollup, project names and a provider toggle.

title: feat(agents): show personal Muse weekly limits
risk: medium - external CLI, undocumented web endpoint
what: Adds an opt-in AI Agents card for personal Muse weekly quota, fetched through the separately installed CodexBar CLI; English-only draft.

title: feat(keep-awake): allow display sleep only while the Mac is locked
what: Adds a Keep Awake sub-option releasing the display sleep assertion once the Mac locks while keeping the system itself awake.

title: feat(notch): add a grow on hover switch for the closed island
what: Adds a default-on switch that disables the closed island's hover emphasis in click-to-open and preview-on-hover modes.

title: feat(agents): let the finished notice leave out the API value
what: Adds a default-on Include the API value option under finished agent notices so cost can be hidden while name and duration remain.

title: feat(command-bar): let names ending in a separator take a query without a space
what: Saved searches or scripts whose name ends in a non-alphanumeric separator can take the query directly, so go/mr opens the go/ link.

title: fix(notch): use a history symbol for recent captures
what: Swaps Recent Captures in the island from camera.viewfinder to clock.arrow.circlepath so it no longer matches the Screenshot tile, with a catalog test.

title: feat(dock-preview): allow an open delay down to 0 ms
what: Lowers the Dock preview open delay to 0 ms, skips window-list prefetch at zero and caps the icon-switch wait at the open delay.

title: fix(command-bar): respect user preferences on restart and shut down
what: Passes state saving preference to System Events for restart and shut down so reopened windows follow the macOS Reopen windows setting.

title: fix(command-bar): let saved search fire without space delimiter
what: Treats non-alphanumeric boundaries after saved search names as delimiters, case and diacritic insensitively, and keeps partial names ranked while typing.

title: fix(mixer): show audio from processes with no regular-app owner
what: Lists actively running audio processes without a regular app owner, such as simulator child processes, as an Other/System audio mixer row.

title: feat(window-layout): add incremental resize actions
what: Adds grow and shrink window actions around the centre with default Control-Option minus/equals shortcuts and a 1-10% per-press slider.

title: perf(startup): stop building services for features that are off
what: Defers ShelfService, BrightnessService restore and CommandBarService warm-up when their features are off, using static helpers and installed-state gating.

title: perf(window-layout): serve pointer layout, gestures and edge snapping from one tap
what: Replaces three window-layout event taps with one shared tap, using a demand set and a fixed directional, gesture then edge-snap routing order.

title: feat(agents): show OpenCode Go plan limits
risk: medium - reads credential DB, undocumented endpoint
what: Reads OpenCode Go five-hour, weekly and monthly limits from the OpenCode usage endpoint using the credential already stored in opencode.db.

title: feat(clipboard): add setting to focus recent copies on opening
what: Adds a default-on Clipboard setting opening at recent items rather than pins, with a Pinned count button and a retry for delayed first copies.

title: fix(audio): re-apply priority when macOS switches to a reconnected device
risk: medium - audio priority heuristics, hardware untested
what: Re-applies the priority list when macOS switches to a just-connected ranked device within a short window and moves Audio priority beside the mixer Options.

title: fix(notch): keep mouse actions inside one slider edit
what: Keeps the island slider's edit open across the whole mouseDown so a late target/action no longer opens a second edit and commits twice.

title: feat(agents): add Antigravity transcript and quota tracking
risk: medium - quota subprocess and transcript readers
what: Smaller Antigravity integration for AI Agents: transcripts, version-gated agy /usage quotas, question notices and locales, bundling the #4093 slider correction.

title: feat(notch): ignore calendar events by title keyword
what: Adds comma-separated title keywords to Calendar settings so matching events show no countdown or time left, optionally hidden from the agenda.

title: fix(settings): export unchanged settings byte-identical
what: Encodes rebuilt settings-export values with sorted keys so repeated exports of an unchanged setup are byte-identical.

title: feat(agents): track gemini cli and antigravity side by side
risk: medium - two readers and quota subprocess
what: Joint integration of the Gemini CLI and Antigravity readers for AI Agents, preserving both authors' commits and reconciling pricing, settings, backup and localization.

title: feat(localization): add indonesian
what: Adds complete Indonesian localization across all catalogs, InfoPlist strings, OCR and command bar, and makes word dates follow the app language everywhere.

title: fix(display): dim virtual displays such as DisplayLink monitors
risk: medium - gamma dimming on virtual displays
what: Lists active virtual displays like DisplayLink monitors in brightness controls and dims them through gamma, skipping DDC and speaker matching.

title: feat(menu-bar): open a combined reading's detail on click
what: Maps clicks through the combined menu bar title's text layout so each pinned metric opens and reanchors its own detail, chaining while open.

title: feat(monitor): deep-link Activity Monitor tabs
risk: medium - Accessibility automation of another app
what: Adds Activity Monitor buttons to metric detail panes and section headers that open the matching CPU, memory, energy, disk or network tab.

title: fix(monitor): hide empty connected devices menu bar reading
what: Hides the Connected Devices menu bar reading while its value is zero and restores it as soon as an external USB device is attached.

title: feat(monitor): add menu bar battery display styles
what: Adds regular, stacked and percentage-inside-icon menu bar battery styles with preview, sanitised preference, localization and image-contract tests.

title: fix(notch): yield to menu bar items revealed beside the island
risk: medium - window levels and CG polling
what: Scopes Show over the menus to compact activity and adds a fast CG overlap check so an idle island lets revealed status items receive clicks.

title: fix(mic-mute): follow an unmute made from a call app
what: Treats a muted microphone being opened while another process records as a user unmute, releasing the mute and restoring the saved input level.

title: feat(agents): read Mistral Vibe session totals
what: Adds Mistral Vibe to AI Agents with per-session token totals read from Vibe 3 projection state and legacy session stats.

title: feat(weather): add weather forecast to menu bar, panel, and notch
risk: high - network service, location, radar licensing
what: Adds an installable Open-Meteo weather feature with menu bar block, panel forecast and charts, RainViewer radar, notch module and opt-in NWS alerts.

title: feat(display): show BetterDisplay brightness in the island
what: Observes BetterDisplay's documented OSD distributed notification and routes brightness changes it handles into the island notice or brightness overlay.

title: fix(notch): start the camera when its page is chosen
what: Opening the island's camera page deliberately starts the mirror immediately instead of requiring a second Open camera click, keeping hover and stopped states off.

title: feat(agents): show in the island when Claude needs your input
risk: high - edits user's Claude settings hooks
what: Adds a Claude needs-you state driven by a hook-written marker file, with island question mark, notice, AI page tag and Settings setup editing ~/.claude/settings.json.

title: feat(agents): choose a dot animation for working agents
what: Adds a Thinking animation menu with seven Canvas dot-matrix styles for working agents, a finished tick, and Reduce Motion stills.

title: Add native media downloader with batch downloads
what: Adds a built-in media downloader with quality choice, live progress, history and CSV, text or JSON batch downloads, integrated into the catalog, Utilities and island.

title: fix(screenshot): number only available capture tools
what: Numbers only installed tools in the screenshot capture chooser so an absent tool no longer shifts digit shortcuts; labels, tooltips and accessibility values follow the same order.

title: fix(display): hide brightness overlay during native capture
risk: low: process scan and window ordering
what: Orders out the Extra Brightness overlay and trigger windows while the native screenshot selector runs, so they stop appearing as capture targets.

title: feat(command-bar): answer dates, spans and time zones in more forms
what: Command Bar answers date words, countdowns, spans, weekday/age facts and time-zone conversions offline using the macOS calendar and zone databases.

title: feat(command-bar): answer calculations, unit conversions and rates
what: Adds Command Bar calculation, unit and dimensional conversion, rates and split-unit results with locale-aware formatting and copy on Return.

title: fix(homebrew): fit installed actions in menu panel
what: Stacks Homebrew's Check packages and Update Homebrew actions on separate lines so longer translations fit inside the fixed-width menu panel.

title: fix(notch): keep pointer hover silent
what: Makes pointer hover that opens the island, shows previews or expands notifications silent, removing trackpad haptics while keeping haptics for direct actions.

title: feat(radial-menu): insert saved text snippets from the wheel
what: Lets a Radial Menu slice run a saved text snippet, storing the snippet ID and reusing the snippet insertion path; requests Accessibility when the wheel has one.

title: fix(brightness): ask the system again when it goes quiet for a display after a wake
what: Rechecks the system brightness route 2, 5 and 15 seconds after a display that previously answered goes quiet post-wake before falling back to DDC.

title: feat(agents): track DeepSeek Harness and Cursor usage
what: Adds DeepSeek Harness and Cursor Agent SDK usage (tokens, cost, models, live turns) to AI Agents plus new provider price tables; supersedes #4146/#4148.

title: feat(agents): add Oh My Pi usage to AI Agents
what: Adds Oh My Pi as a fifth agent, reading its statistics database for turns, tokens, cost, models and projects, with a settings switch and privacy notes.

title: feat(disk-image-installer): show real install progress
risk: medium: installer copy path and quarantine
what: Replaces ditto with copyfile so the disk-image install card shows real byte-based progress, keeping metadata and stripping quarantine per copied item.

title: feat(brightness): switch a monitor's input from the keyboard
risk: medium: DDC input writes can blank screen
what: Adds an opt-in global shortcut that moves a monitor to its next DDC/CI input, with capability parsing, confirmation reads and Displays settings rows.

title: fix(mic-mute): keep unmute from getting stuck
what: Fixes microphone unmute getting stuck by tracking the in-flight mute request and detaching device listeners before restoring gain.

title: feat(notch): add Always to open the separate window from the island too
what: Adds an Always tick box so island rows set to Separate window open the feature's own window directly from the island, backed up and localized.

title: feat: Disk Storage Map (Utilities treemap)
risk: medium: Full Disk Access, recursive scan
what: Adds an opt-in Disk Storage Map utility with nested treemap scanning, drill-down, breadcrumbs, Reveal in Finder and Move to Trash.

title: fix(notch): unify the Quick panel and Shelf names in the island
what: Renames the island's Tools and Files sections to Quick panel and Shelf so island labels, drop targets and settings rows match the rest of the app.

title: Watch: choose a louder alert, or keep it repeating
what: Watch alerts can use any system alert sound and optionally repeat every couple of seconds for up to five minutes until the user opens Watch.

title: Media: type any image resize size, not just stepper jumps
what: Replaces Media image-resize steppers with typed pixel fields, allowing exact sizes like 144x144 within the supported range.

title: fix(display): show monitor volume feedback on key press
what: Shows the requested monitor volume immediately on key press and corrects the bar after monitor confirmation or a rejected write.

title: feat(agents): show OpenCode Go limits and value
what: Fetches OpenCode Go session and weekly allowance from its local loopback usage endpoint so limits cards, strip readouts and alerts work.

title: feat(layout-fix): fix words typed in the wrong keyboard layout
what: Adds Layout Fix: a lone Right Option tap retypes the last word or selection in another enabled keyboard layout and switches the input source.

title: feat(notch): join Zoom/Teams/Meet from calendar
what: Detects Zoom, Teams and Meet links on calendar events, adds Join Meeting to the agenda menu and an optional Join icon on the island countdown.

title: feat(clipboard): preview copied files and drag history entries
risk: medium: file snapshots and sandbox grants
what: Lets clipboard history be dragged into other apps and previews copied files with Quick Look thumbnails and document contents instead of private paths.

title: perf(images): bound cached icon and thumbnail memory
what: Downsamples cached icon and thumbnail bitmaps and adds byte cost caps to wallpaper, clipboard and screenshot caches to cut memory use.

title: feat(agents): show limits for each account a CLIProxyAPI hub pools
risk: medium: network hub calls, key storage
what: Adds CLIProxyAPI hubs so pooled Claude and Codex accounts each get limits cards, with key storage, refusal states, polling bounds and privacy limits.

title: fix(fan-control): re-apply kept control after a safety stop
what: Re-applies the kept fan-control configuration with backoff after the helper's safety stop, gated on thermal pressure and user intent.

title: fix(notch): give recent captures its own icon
what: Gives the island's Recent Captures page its own photo.stack symbol instead of sharing the Screenshot camera icon.

title: fix(command-bar): make the island's selected row readable
what: Raises the selected-row fill contrast inside the island's command bar while leaving the window presentation at its existing opacity.

title: fix(menu-bar): keep a click inside the panel from dismissing it
what: Ignores global mouse-down events landing inside the panel content view so the first in-panel click no longer switches tab and closes the panel.

title: feat(agents): monitor multiple Claude accounts, with shared-history fixes
what: Extends multi-Claude-account monitoring: keeps every account, fixes shared or symlinked history attribution, per-account limits, spend split and update stalls.

title: fix(notch): let a swipe skip songs over the new song notice
what: Treats the closed island's new-song notice as a music surface so sideways swipes keep skipping songs while the notice is showing.

title: fix(display): step a monitor's volume without reading it first
what: Steps monitor volume directly from the last reading when it is under three seconds old, cutting DDC exchanges and confirming once after the burst.

title: feat(agents): track Command Code usage and plan limits
what: Adds Command Code to AI Agents: usage from local session logs, plan limits polled from its account, a settings switch and a drawn mark.

title: feat(agents): track Antigravity usage, turns and plan limits
risk: medium: runs agy CLI, keychain prompt
what: Adds Antigravity to AI Agents: turns and timers from chat files, token usage records, quota limits via its agy CLI, a switch and drawn mark.

title: feat(switcher): add option to turn off stepping back with Shift alone
what: Adds a Switcher option, on by default, that stops a bare Shift press from selecting the previous item while a session is open.

title: fix(window-layout): keep gaps below a menu bar the visible frame ignores
what: Cuts the layout frame below an uncovered secondary-display menu bar that visibleFrame still includes, restoring the top screen gap.

title: fix(menu-panel): close the panel when Settings opens
what: Closes the menu bar panel when Settings opens so it no longer covers Settings until an outside click.

title: feat(agents): follow Cursor in Dynamic Island AI Agents
what: Adds Cursor as an AI Agents provider using local agent transcripts for live turns, project names and finish notices, plus SDK pinning for MakeIcon.

title: feat(notch): add app and website side shortcuts
risk: medium: network icon fetch, private paths
what: Adds individually managed app, CrossOver and website buttons around the island, with validated URL fetching, icon caching and backup exclusions.

title: feat(battery): add opt-in battery care controls
what: Adds opt-in Battery Care with charge limits, recharge range, temperature protection, top-up, discharge, calibration and schedules via the privileged helper.

title: Add MacOS Widgets
what: Adds six Notification Centre and desktop widgets (CPU, GPU, memory, disk, combined, network) and splits English and Brazilian Portuguese localization files.

title: fix(notch): keep menu bar icons out from under the island
risk: high: status item churn, prior freeze
what: Adds a menu bar gap status item and strip fitting so island content stops covering status items, with heavily bounded republish and measurement logic.

title: Color menu bar values by usage and temperature level
what: Colors menu bar metric values by configured usage thresholds and fixed temperature levels, matching the existing Bars mode signal.

title: fix(homebrew): keep the installed filter inside the menu panel
what: Replaces the Homebrew Installed tab's segmented filter with width-sharing buttons so panel content no longer clips in other languages or with large counts.

title: feat(mixer): keep a locked microphone at its saved input volume
what: Adds an opt-in input-volume lock restoring a saved microphone level after outside changes, with mute, device and failed-write safeguards; never compiled on macOS.

title: Feat/pomodoro
what: Adds a Pomodoro timer to Quick Tools with work, short and long break phases, configurable durations, sounds, notifications and a global shortcut.

title: fix(window-layout): resize a shrinking window before moving it
what: Resizes a shrinking window before moving it during layout placements so the in-between frame stays inside the old one and slow apps stop flickering.

title: fix(window-maximizer): leave the screen gap when maximizing
what: Makes the green-button maximizer honour the configured screen gap so it matches the layout Maximize shortcut's size.

title: feat(switcher): add option for Tab to step through windows in icon row
what: Adds an opt-in Switcher option so Tab visits each of an app's windows in the large-icons layout before moving to the next app.

title: feat(switcher): preview the selected window in place behind the switcher
what: Optionally draws a ScreenCaptureKit screenshot and accent outline of the selected window behind the switcher; depends on #4256.

title: feat(keep-awake): add optional mute on lid close
risk: low: reuses existing lid and audio controls
what: Adds an opt-in setting that mutes audio when the lid closes during closed-lid keep-awake and restores the previous state on open.

title: feat(notch): track Kimi Code and Oh My Pi usage and limits
risk: medium: new CLI and DB readers
what: Adds Kimi Code limits and opt-in Oh My Pi session usage, limits cards and live turns, superseding #3972 on current main.

title: feat(mouse): add trackpad edge sliders for volume and brightness
what: Adds opt-in trackpad edge sliders that change brightness or volume with one-finger vertical slides, with edge width, sensitivity, haptics and direction settings.

title: feat(notch): add mission control to floating shortcuts
what: Adds Mission Control as an optional island floating quick action that triggers the configured macOS Mission Control shortcut.

title: fix(keyboard): keep settings open on macs without a keyboard backlight
what: Fixes a Settings crash on Macs lacking keyboard backlight by making the KeyboardBrightnessClient bridge return optional and treating nil as unsupported.

title: fix(notch): let a silent banner expire while the pointer holds it
what: Reorders guards in holdNotification so a silent banner still expires while the pointer holds it instead of staying indefinitely.

title: fix(settings): write the exported settings file the same way every run
what: Makes exported settings byte-identical across runs by sorting keys in every JSON value the backup path re-encodes.

title: feat(menu-panel): offer Kill Process in the Utilities section
what: Adds a Kill Process tile to the menu panel Utilities section with a searchable process list and kill/force-kill actions reusing the existing service.

title: fix(super-key): wait for a keyboard instead of reporting a foreign mapping
what: Treats an empty hidutil report as no keyboard yet rather than a foreign mapping, so Super Key survives login before Bluetooth keyboards connect.
